{{Quote|I am Darth Venamis.''"<br />"''Darth? We'll see about that.''"<br />"''Your death will legitimize the title, Plagueis.|Darth Venamis and Darth Plagueis|<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
The '''contest on Sojourn''' occurred in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] on the planet of Sojourn, where [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Plagueis resided after he hosted the [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]] there. After he hosted his event, his [[Sun Guard]]s brought news that an intruder penetrated the building's defenses. Plagueis immediately sensed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] being, whom he at first perceived as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. In the forests, he confronted the disturbance, a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] with a Sith [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. At first, he believed it to be his former Master, [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]], then perceived the Bith as Tenebrous's offspring, a product of Bith science. The Bith identified himself as [[Darth Venamis]], and that Plagueis' [[Death/Legends|death]] would legitimize the [[Darth/Legends|''Darth'']] title.

==The duel==
The duel was short, but furious. Tenebrous had taught Venamis the fighting style that Plagueis had adopted so it was hard at first for the Muun to strike, though in the end, Plagueis disarmed Venamis and held his and Venamis's weapon at his neck forcing the Bith to surrender. Venamis ultimately decided to apprentice himself to Plagueis, though the Muun forced the Bith to [[Poison/Legends|poison]] himself with a root of the local fauna, causing him to enter a [[Coma/Legends|comatose]] state to allow Plagueis to experiment on him, with the help of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]].
